component.name: NAM Audio Pipe
component.summary: Low-latency PipeWire standalone host for Neural Amp Modeler

description.p: NAM-Audio-Pipe is an ultra-low latency, real-time standalone PipeWire host application for Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) simulation on Linux, engineered in pure Rust with strict real-time safety.

ul.li: Direct native PipeWire integration (libpipewire-0.3) at low quantum buffer sizes (down to 64 samples).
Inherited NeuralAmpModeler-rs DSP engine supporting WaveNet (A1/A2 standard and lite) and LSTM topologies.
Strict real-time safety: zero heap allocations, zero mutex locks, and zero blocking calls on the audio loop.
Integrated CabSim Impulse Response (IR) loader and zero-latency partitioned convolution.
Concurrent asynchronous 32-bit float WAV recording powered by Linux io_uring with 4 GiB auto-split and noise gate trim.
Half-band polyphase anti-aliasing oversampling (2× and 4×) and adaptive compute auto-slimming.

description.p: NAM-Audio-Pipe 0.5.0 release with Flatpak metadata and PipeWire integration.

ul.li: WaveNet and LSTM neural model inference with SIMD AVX2 acceleration.
Integrated CabSim IR convolver and io_uring WAV recorder.
